Prophecy: Believers Shall Do Greater Works Than These
ProphecySummary: Jesus predicts that he who believes in him shall do the works he does, and greater works than these, because he goes to his Father.
Fulfillment: Partially fulfilled: the apostles' Spirit-empowered mission reached wider scope than Jesus's earthly ministry (Acts), and the mission continues; 'greater' is read here as greater in scope through his going to the Father, not greater in kind.
